م: م [The twenty-fourth letter of the alphabet; called مِيمٌ. It is one of the letters termed مَجْهُورَة, or vocal, and of those termed شَفَهِيَّة or labial: it is a letter of augmentation. ___ As a numeral, it denotes forty.]

م مَ for the interrogative مَا immediately following a prep.: see مَا in the S, K; and إِلَى last sentence. === مِ for مِنْ: see an ex., from a poet, voce رُبَّ. === مُ ٱللّٰهِ &c.: see أَيْمُنُ اللّٰهِ. === مّ for أُمّ: see the latter.
